title: DeliveryLoopPolicy
description: Opts a Work Package into autonomous execution.

repo.description: Project-relative Git repository directory; empty or . = the project root.

requireChecks.description: Wait for the host's CI checks before the review; repair recoverable failures (bounded by maxRepairs).

readyForReview.description: Open the pull request ready for review instead of as a draft (default).

repository.description: Id of a repository linked in .amaru/project.yaml; exclusive with repo. Used only for a trusted project.

refreshBase.description: Merge a moved base branch into an open pull request waiting for checks or a merge, and push the merge commit. Default false.

commitInclude.description: Patterns of new files that look like agent scratch but are deliverables; a trailing / covers a directory. Set by a person. Without a match, such files stay out of the commit and are reported.
